capability_boundary: MODEL = local text generation only (no network, no files, no device access). TOOLS = optional plug-in tool libraries; only the ones you load run, and only as ordinary page JavaScript. DEFAULT = no network calls. Currently free for all internet tasks.
creator: Justin Addam Higgins
description: A tiny transformer language model I built and trained from scratch on the IWB Dictionary and Signature spec text. Runs entirely in the browser: no API keys, no servers, no fees — currently free for all internet tasks.

determinism.deterministic_mode: Pass deterministic:true (site-level LlamaRuntime.generate) to force temperature 0: greedy argmax, same prompt always gives the same output. Tested with the published weights: identical prompt twice -> byte-identical output.
determinism.note: Without deterministic:true or seed, temperature>0 sampling uses Math.random and is intentionally non-deterministic.
determinism.seed: Pass seed:<integer> (site-level) to run sampling through a seeded mulberry32 PRNG installed for the duration of generation, then restored. Same prompt + same seed -> identical output.

engine_version_lock.note: The site loader verifies the weight binary header (magic 'SGLL', format version 1) before the engine parses it, and refuses to load on mismatch (named failure MODEL_CORRUPT).

BROWSER_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: The browser is missing APIs the engine needs (fetch, Blob, URL, typed arrays).

ENGINE_LOAD_FAILED.meaning: The engine script sigllama.js could not be downloaded or parsed.

GENERATION_TIMEOUT.meaning: Generation did not finish within the requested timeoutMs. The model is small; this usually means the tab is throttled or frozen.

MODEL_CORRUPT.meaning: The weight binary failed its header check (magic 'SGLL', format version 1) or failed to parse.

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.meaning: vocab.json or sigllama-v1.bin returned 404 at the model base URL.

NETWORK_REQUIRED.meaning: The browser reports it is offline and the engine/weights are not cached yet. First load needs internet.

OUT_OF_MEMORY.meaning: The browser ran out of memory while allocating the model (~3 MB weights expand to tens of MB of Float32 tensors).

identity.name: Signature Llama: The Fully Cyber Utilizable AI

license: Free for any website, app, or project. No API key, no fee, credit appreciated. Independent model by Justin Addam Higgins, not affiliated with Meta.
limitations: v1 is small (~3M parameters), lively, and a little quirky — like a bright intern. It can invent facts; verify anything important.
Context window is 128 tokens: the prompt is left-truncated to fit, so long conversations lose their oldest turns first.
Character-level tokenizer: spelling is fine, but long words cost many tokens.
No tools run by default: the model only generates text. Tool libraries run only when you load them.
Sampling with temperature > 0 is intentionally non-deterministic unless you pass deterministic:true or seed.
Offline use after first load depends on the browser's HTTP cache and has not been lab-tested.
llms_txt_derivation: llms.txt is generated from this manifest plus model-status.json by build_llms.py (repo root). Do not hand-edit llms.txt; regenerate it.

model.runtime: pure JavaScript, zero dependencies, runs in browser
model.tokenizer: character-level, 84 tokens, trained on creator's own text
model.training_data: IWB Dictionary definitions + Signature spec text (creator-authored)

name: Signature Llama: The Fully Cyber Utilizable AI
offline: First load needs an internet connection (engine + ~3 MB weights). Afterwards the browser's HTTP cache can serve the files offline. Offline use is not guaranteed and has not been lab-tested.
purpose: Model home for Signature Llama: talk to the trained model in the browser, look up LLM/AI terms, learn how language models work, plug in tool libraries, and copy the engine into your own sites. The same engine and weights are the talking brain inside every AI in the Signature AI Telephone Book.

backend.name: The Signature Backend
backend.tie: Hosts the published engine and weights.

telephone_book.name: The Signature AI Telephone Book
telephone_book.tie: The book loads the SAME engine file and the SAME weights (same base URL, same SHA-256) and routes every AI chat through it with a per-AI persona prompt (maxTokens 100, temperature 0.75, topK 40).

sampling.context_length_interaction: Prompt tokens are left-truncated to (context_length - maxTokens - 2): larger maxTokens leaves less room for the prompt. The KV cache holds exactly context_length positions.

stopAtEos.meaning: Stop generation when the end-of-sequence token is sampled.

temperature.deterministic_setting: temperature 0 (or deterministic:true) = greedy argmax = fully deterministic
temperature.temperature_0_behavior: temperature <= 0 always picks the highest-scoring token: no randomness, same prompt gives the same output every time

topK.meaning: Sample only from the K highest-scoring tokens.
topK.valid: integer >= 1; applies only when 1 <= topK < vocabulary size (84), otherwise the full vocabulary is used

corpus_injection_test.findings: No 'ignore previous instructions' payloads. No 'system:' overrides. No 'you are now' redefinitions. 24 mentions of the word 'jailbreak' are dictionary definitions ABOUT jailbreaking as an evaluation concept, not attack prompts. 1 'override' hit is the dictionary word 'override' itself. Training text is descriptive, not instructive.
corpus_injection_test.method: Regex scan of the full training corpus plus the on-site dictionary for: ignore-previous-instructions patterns, system-prompt overrides, 'you are now' redefinitions, jailbreak/DAN payloads, instruction-override phrases.

security.model_output_policy: Model output is treated as plain text only. The site never eval()s or executes generated text. Tool libraries are shipped code, never model-generated.
security.prompt_injection_containment: (1) The training corpus is creator-authored dictionary definitions and spec text, sanitized at build time (URLs stripped, 20-420 char lines, deduped, seed 614). (2) The 2026-10-01 scan found no privileged-instruction payloads in the corpus. (3) At runtime, model output is rendered as text and never executed. (4) Tool libraries are fixed shipped code registered under SigLlama.tools — the model cannot add or modify tools.
security.training_text_is_descriptive: Definitions describe concepts (including attack concepts like jailbreaking, in an evaluation context); they do not contain instructions addressed to the model.

related_records: JAH-AI telephone book entries (all route through this engine)

corpus.sanitization: URLs stripped, whitespace collapsed, lines kept only if 20-420 chars and >=60% letters/spaces, deduped, shuffled with seed 614

industry_standard.what: The 'Llama · Industry Standard' mode on the site: the full-scale Llama the industry runs (Llama 3.3 70B by default; Llama 4 Maverick / Llama 4 Scout selectable), served live from the cloud by Groq. It is NOT the on-device Signature Llama v1 — the two are labeled differently on every reply (⬢ vs ✦) and cannot be confused.
industry_standard.not_affiliated: Llama weights are by Meta; this site and its Signature extras are an independent project by Justin Addam Higgins, not affiliated with Meta.
industry_standard.local_vs_cloud: LOCAL = ✦ Signature Llama v1 (SIGLLAMA-V1, 2,983,488 parameters, runs in the browser, no key). CLOUD = ⬢ Industry Standard (full-scale Llama, cloud-served, needs a free API key).

api_key.where: Free key from https://console.groq.com/keys (no credit card). Pasted in the Industry Standard box above the site chat, or via IndustryLlama.setKey(key).
api_key.storage: Browser localStorage only (key 'sigllama_industry_key'). Never stored on any server — the site is static hosting.
api_key.destination: The key is sent ONLY to https://api.groq.com — never to any Signature site or any other host.
api_key.missing_key_behavior: Send refuses clearly with code MISSING_KEY: 'Industry Standard needs your free API key first — paste it in the box above the chat, hit Connect, then send again. v1 keeps working meanwhile.'

industry_standard.system_prompt_note: Industry replies carry a system prompt that forbids claiming to be the small on-device Signature Llama v1.
industry_standard.choice_storage: The model picker choice ('v1' | 'industry') persists in browser localStorage key 'sigllama_model_choice'; default 'v1'.
